_comment: Reviewed ceilings for the acceptance-state debt counters (#31, #164). The first seven are ways a completion claim can outrun its evidence; the last three (#164) are ways the ADR -> spec -> AC chain is simply absent -- a spec implementing nothing, a decided ADR nothing implements, a spec owing criteria -- each of which was clean under every existing check, because a validator can only refuse a link that was written down wrongly. Each counter and each may only go down: a rise is a new contradiction entering the repository, and a fall that has not been banked is slack a later regression could spend. Enforced by scripts/check-ac-state.py --ratchet, which refuses to compare across measurement modes -- without --run-tests no criterion can reach the passing rung, so the counters mean something different. Bank a reviewed improvement with --ratchet --bank and read the diff; never hand-edit a number to match a delta.
